title: Pure Krawler
summary: Krawler cards and their World Legacy support, with generic Insect Links and staples. Krawlers are Level 2 Flip monsters. Each one does something when flipped, such as searching, destroying a card or reviving, and each summons two different Krawlers face-down from the Deck when the opponent removes it from the field. Krawler Receptor searches another Krawler, and World Legacy in Shadow puts a Level 2 Insect on the field every turn. Krawler Soma, the newest card, flips one of your monsters face-down to summon itself, then lowers its Level to pull Krawlers with that total Level from the hand, Deck or GY. Deus X-Krawler negates every monster effect the opponent activates once flipped. World Legacy's Mind Meld turns their monster effect into bouncing one of their own monsters. World Legacy Survivor limits the Extra Deck to Links.
